tenures.note: The dedicated bio card gives a kayfabe "Real Name" of Wayne Rothschild (matching the ring name) and a birthdate of 6 September 1972 — character content per the fed's own bio-card template. Won the EWA North American Championship, then was crippled and retired, then became a Vice President and eventually President of the fed after President Artful's departure; the 3 June 1999 site credits him as owner and cites "President Rothschild" as the contact for fed business.
